def comb_sort(arr):
    arr = arr[:]
    n = len(arr)
    gap = n
    shrink = 1.3
    swapped = True
    
    while gap > 1 or swapped:
        gap = int(gap / shrink)
        if gap < 1:
            gap = 1
        swapped = False
        
        for i in range(n - gap):
            if arr[i] > arr[i + gap]:
                arr[i], arr[i + gap] = arr[i + gap], arr[i]
                swapped = True
    
    return arr
```
